retained_r1_failure.cause_and_scope: Constant p plus uniform horizontal Ax1 does not guarantee exact tangency to the actual reconstructed GPU normal. With Gp/Lp/DA/theta0 the closed Taylor action is B*k/gamma*rhow*Nx*(N dot Lx)/(N dot N), generally nonzero. CPU and GPU closed projection algebra are the same, but CPU FS uses double coordinate differences whereas GPU FS uses float PosCell differences. R2 fixes the test premise, not a production equation or arithmetic tolerance. Original r1 remains false and unchanged; r2 is not a retroactive pass.
